decision.title: XSLT conformance sweep: streamed availability, fn:document's options, the driver's tree delivery (packet 4.26)

body.p: , after , , , , . Verified as asks: the debug preset (the xslt, xslt_driver, function_library, json, xpath, evaluator_stream and cli tests), clang-tidy on the changed files, the call-cycle check, the book examples (), QT4 XP40/XQ40 sets of the changed functions, and the whole XT40 suite with the release driver after each change, case by case. XT40 12,191 to 12,209 passed (118 wrong error), 327 to 309 failed, 0 errors, run at 5a855ca plus 2.24's commits ('s 12,187 was before them). Commits 4e0ffdb, 3d97421, 564d293, e1188ef, 9024849, 2ff5431, 67f7ad2.

item.p: fn:stream-available (18.2) opens the document as xsl:source-document streamable="yes" does and reads only its head (sxml_evaluator_stream_check_available, src/evaluator_stream.c, the incremental parse of /): stream-available-004/005 pass.

fn:document's options map (20.1) is fn:doc's (sxml_function_library_read_document_options): trust-external (FODC0016), dtd-validation (FODC0007, also without DOCTYPE), strip-space "all", xinclude (FODC0013), xsd-validation. Deviation: the draft's default trust-external false applies only to a call with a map; a node or no second argument (the 3.0 forms) still reads external DTDs through the resolver, as the "explicitly enabled" access of 20.1 allows: the draft's default for them lost base-uri-051b, catalog-004/006/012 and docbook-001/002, which rely on 3.0's behaviour. strip-space "none" is not done (the loader applies xsl:strip-space to every document it caches; document-4031).
Untrusted text functions: fn:unparsed-text-available and fn:json-doc check trust as fn:unparsed-text does (FODC0016, false).

Self-reference of globals (9.5, PR 1544): no longer XPST0008; a needed self-reference is XTDE0640 when read. variable-0120 (3.0's XPST0008) goes to wrong error as the draft decides; variable-4901 and higher-order-functions-070a still fail because XSLT's inline functions capture globals by value (src/xpath_lower.c, the capture of free variables: XQuery reads its globals at call time, ; XSLT could too).

The XSLT driver delivers the principal result as a tree unless <output tree="no">, as the reference runner does (fn:transform's default delivery-format "document"); json and adaptive outputs' "/out" assertions had raised XPDY0050 (4 cases).

Smaller: FODC0002 from the document loader names the URI reference (try-018/019; the CLI's message and the book's files.md change); a library package's xsl:global-context-item is ignored unless use="required" (XTTE0590), XTSE3087 compares within one package; fn:resolve-uri refuses a second "#" (FORG0002).

The draft decides, left (): array:members gives JNodes, not value records (for-each-array-001 to -003); XQDY0137 for duplicate map constructor keys (sx-MapExpr-007, si-fork-814: XTDE3365 is xsl:map's); an initial named template must be public or final (2.4.4, XTDE0040: accumulator-038, su-filter-101/102 in xsl:package principals); FODC0016, not FODC0002, for fn:doc in untrusted xsl:evaluate (evaluate-450, -457, -458; QT4 fn-load-xquery-module-521 agrees); the suite's XXXX9999 (evaluate-453, -455, -456, -459).

Found for the XPath sweep (2.25): "E//S/T/f()" lowers "//" as E/descendant-or-self::node()/(S/T/f()), right-nested, so S/T is not in document order without duplicates before the non-node last step: //PRICE/ancestor::*/name() gives every ancestor once per PRICE (src/xpath_lower.c, begin_absolute_path and the RELATIVE_PATH link with DOUBLE_SLASH; "/descendant-or-self::node()/PRICE/..." is right). It fails sx-square-array-035/-135, sf-insert-before-035/-135, square-array-035, and affects XQuery alike.

Left, with causes: CDATA text nodes merge with adjacent text (text-012/-019/-020, value-of-012; 11.4.3 makes it implementation-defined); static XTSE0020 for a fixed invalid start-at (number-0109, error-1001a: read_fixed_text is private to src/xslt_lower_construct.c); key match patterns over namespace nodes (key-087/-090); 's casts and collations of inner static contexts; the rest of 's single cases.
The XT40 section of docs/CONFORMANCE.md was not regenerated: the file has another packet's uncommitted changes.
